products.title: Corrected Reflectance (True Color, VIIRS, NOAA-20)
products.note: Natural-color daily mosaic; clouds and swath gaps are visible as published.

products.title: Corrected Reflectance (True Color, MODIS, Terra)
products.note: Natural-color daily mosaic (morning overpass).

products.title: Corrected Reflectance (Bands 7-2-1, MODIS, Terra)
products.note: Bands 7-2-1: burn scars red-brown, water dark, vegetation green, snow/ice cyan.

products.title: Corrected Reflectance (M11-I2-I1, VIIRS, Suomi NPP)
products.note: Bands M11-I2-I1: similar to 7-2-1 at higher resolution.

products.title: At Sensor Radiance (Day/Night Band, VIIRS, Suomi NPP)
products.note: Night-time light and moonlit clouds as observed by the Day/Night Band.

products.title: Black Marble (VIIRS, Suomi NPP)
products.note: Annual composite of night lights (not a single night).

products.title: Land Surface Temperature (Day, MODIS, Terra)
products.note: Satellite-retrieved land surface (skin) temperature, daytime; not air temperature.

products.title: Air Temperature at Surface (L3, Daytime/Ascending, Daily, AIRS, Aqua)
products.note: Retrieved near-surface air temperature, daily daytime pass, coarse resolution.

products.title: Cloud Top Temperature (Day, MODIS, Terra)
products.note: Temperature at the top of clouds.

products.title: Vegetation Index (rolling 8-Day, MODIS, Terra)
products.note: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index, rolling 8-day composite.

products.title: Enhanced Vegetation Index (rolling 8-Day, MODIS, Terra)
products.note: Enhanced Vegetation Index, rolling 8-day composite.

products.title: Dark Target Aerosol Optical Depth (Land and Ocean, MODIS, Terra)
products.note: Aerosol optical depth (haze, smoke, dust) over land and ocean.

products.title: Aerosol Index (OMPS, Suomi NPP)
products.note: UV aerosol index: absorbing aerosols such as smoke and dust.

products.title: Corrected Reflectance (Bands 7-2-1, MODIS, Terra)
products.note: Use with the Active fire detections data layer (FIRMS) for detections; burn scars appear red-brown here.

products.title: Snow Cover (Normalized Difference Snow Index, MODIS, Terra)
products.note: Snow cover from the Normalized Difference Snow Index (daily; clouds hide the surface).

products.title: Precipitation Rate (IMERG)
products.note: Satellite precipitation rate estimate (IMERG), half-hourly product shown per day.

products.title: Land Cover Type (L3, IGBP, Annual, MODIS, Aqua+Terra)
products.note: Annual land-cover classification (IGBP classes).

products.title: Root Zone Soil Moisture (L4, 12z Instantaneous, Model Value-Added, SMAP)
products.note: Model-assimilated root-zone soil moisture (analysis, not a direct observation).

products.title: Sea Surface Temperature (L4, MUR, GHRSST)
products.note: Gap-filled analysis of sea surface temperature (L4).

products.title: Chlorophyll A (L2, MODIS, Aqua)
products.note: Ocean chlorophyll-a concentration (L2 swaths; gaps under clouds).

products.title: Liquid Water Equivalent Thickness (Mascon, CRI,  GRACE Tellus)
products.note: Monthly change in total water storage inferred from gravity (GRACE/GRACE-FO), relative to a 2004–2009 baseline; coarse (~300 km).

products.title: Carbon Monoxide (L2, 500 hPa, Day, AIRS, Aqua)
products.note: Carbon monoxide at 500 hPa (mid-troposphere), not ground-level air quality.

products.title: Aerosol Optical Depth (Value Added, MODIS, Combined Aqua and Terra)
products.note: Aerosol optical depth (combined Terra/Aqua); a proxy for particulate haze, not PM2.5.
